title: Move to the Beat
description: Integrated enrichment lesson for student practice and teacher review.

steps.title: Practice moving to the beat
steps.description: Learn a tap, clap, and pause sequence, then follow a steady beat in a comfortable way.

configuration.question: Has a teacher confirmed that the movement is appropriate and the space is clear?
configuration.correct_feedback: Ready. Use the approved movement or an appropriate adapted version.
configuration.retry_feedback: Pause and ask the teacher to confirm movement readiness and safe space.
configuration.content_description: Teacher confirmation is required before physical participation.
Ask your teacher to approve or adapt these actions. You can follow the cards while seated, point to them, or imagine the actions.

steps.title: 1. Tap
steps.description: Gently tap your lap or desk once.
steps.alt_text: Two rhythm sticks used for tapping

steps.title: 2. Clap
steps.description: Clap once, or bring your hands together comfortably.

steps.title: 3. Pause
steps.description: Rest for one beat. Start again only when ready.

configuration.question: The sequence repeats: tap, clap, pause. What comes next?

slides.title: Make the Routine Work for You

configuration.question: Choose what helps in each practice situation. Then ask your teacher about trying a comfortable version of tap, clap, pause.
configuration.content_description: With teacher approval, try the pattern seated (tap a hand on your lap, clap gently, pause) or standing (tap a foot, clap gently, pause). Your teacher can adapt or stop any action. You may point to the cues or observe instead. Screen answers show sequencing knowledge, not physical performance. Your teacher records any directly observed performance separately in your learning profile.
